===============================================================================
Layered-VQA — 1 conversation per condition (16 conditions)
Local model: qwen3.5-9b (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B via vLLM on localhost:8000)
Datasets:    single-sample pilot files, task_id lvis_000000569697::direct_ask
===============================================================================

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 0 — run this ONCE per shell, before any command below
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every command must run from vendor/conv-smi: prompts, the judge cache and
# logs/ are all opened by RELATIVE path. From anywhere else the first file
# open fails with FileNotFoundError.

cd <path>/Code/Layered-VQA/vendor/conv-smi
export VLLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1
PY=<path>/Code/Layered-VQA/.venv/bin/python
D=../../data/derived/lic
M="--models qwen3.5-9b --judge_model qwen3.5-9b --user_model qwen3.5-9b"
TEXT=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_text.json
CANON=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_visual_canonical.json
GROUND=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_grounding.json
ORACLE=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_oracle_gold.json

# Sanity check (offline, no model calls):
$PY agent_config.py --model qwen3.5-9b


===============================================================================
EXP-A
===============================================================================

--- 1. FULL — full image + full question (also EXP-A condition 1: RGB answer only) ---
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$TEXT $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $TEXT \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M \
  --N_full_runs 1 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 0 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
  --N_workers 1

--- 1b. EXP-A condition 2 — full img + ALL layers, answer AND layer selection ---
# Single turn. This is the only dataset whose samples set
# meta.response_format=answer_and_layers, so it is the only one that gets the
# layer-selection prompt and per-conversation layer metrics.
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$GROUND $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $GROUND \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M \
  --N_full_runs 1 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 0 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
  --N_workers 1

--- 1c. EXP-A condition 3 — oracle: only a gold minimal sufficient layer set ---
# Upper-bound diagnostic, not a fair retrieval result. No full RGB, no
# background unless it is itself gold, ordinary answer-only prompt.
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$ORACLE $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $ORACLE \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M \
  --N_full_runs 1 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 0 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
  --N_workers 1

--- EXP-A metrics table (after 1, 1b and 1c) ---
# Reads logs/layered_vqa/full/ and splits the three conditions by dataset_fn.
$PY score_experiment_a.py --datasets pilot_layered_vqa_text.json \
  pilot_layered_vqa_grounding.json pilot_layered_vqa_oracle_gold.json


===============================================================================
VISUAL
===============================================================================

--- 6. CONCAT_V — full question + ALL visual layers together ---
# This is a `full`-type run on the canonical visual export, NOT --N_concat_runs:
# that file's `question` field is the whole question and its shards carry every
# layer. Do NOT use aligned_vq here — that file has only the gold layers, which
# is an evidence-only control, a different condition.
# No --user_agent needed: the guard only fires when --N_sharded_runs > 0.
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$CANON $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $CANON \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M \
  --N_full_runs 1 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 0 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
  --N_workers 1

--- 7. SHARDED_V — one new layer per turn, priors stay in context ---
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$CANON $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $CANON \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M --user_agent scripted \
  --N_full_runs 0 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 1 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
  --N_workers 1

--- 8. RECAP_V — after SHARDED_V, provide the full RGB image again ---
# MUST run after #7.
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$CANON $PY simulator_recap.py --task layered_vqa \
  --models qwen3.5-9b --judge_model qwen3.5-9b --N_workers 1

--- 9. SNOWBALL_V — every turn re-attaches all revealed layers plus the new one ---
# A 6-layer scene can peak at 21 images in one prompt. Verified OK: this server
# accepts 24 images per prompt, so no --limit-mm-per-prompt restart is needed.
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$CANON $PY simulator_snowball.py --task layered_vqa \
  --user_agent scripted $M --N_snowball_runs 1 --N_workers 1


===============================================================================
MAIN — SHARDED_VQ
===============================================================================

--- 10. SHARDED_VQ — aligned (supporting layers) vs misaligned (non-supporting) ---
for V in aligned_vq misaligned_vq; do
  F=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_$V.json
  LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$F $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $F \
    --tasks layered_vqa $M --user_agent scripted \
    --N_full_runs 0 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 1 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
    --N_workers 1
done

# NOTE for the full 300-sample run: 15 of 300 questions have a layer supported by
# EVERY shard, so strict misalignment is impossible and the residual pairings are
# listed in meta.misaligned_violations. Exclude those samples from any
# aligned-vs-misaligned contrast. (The pilot sample has none — it is clean.)


===============================================================================
ADDITIONAL
===============================================================================

--- 11/12. EVIDENCE_FIRST_V / EVIDENCE_LAST_V ---
# first = necessary evidence before distractors; last = distractors first.
for V in visual_evidence_first visual_evidence_last; do
  F=$D/pilot_layered_vqa_$V.json
  LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$F $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $F \
    --tasks layered_vqa $M --user_agent scripted \
    --N_full_runs 0 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 1 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 0 \
    --N_workers 1
done

--- 13. SHUFFLE_Q-CONCAT — non-intent shards concatenated in random order ---
LAYERED_VQA_DATASET=$TEXT $PY run_simulations.py --dataset_file $TEXT \
  --tasks layered_vqa $M \
  --N_full_runs 0 --N_concat_runs 0 --N_sharded_runs 0 --N_shuffle_concat_runs 1 \
  --N_workers 1

SHUFFLED_SHARDED_Q was dropped from Experiment B; the `scripted-shuffle` user
agent that served it still works if you want to run it ad hoc.


===============================================================================
GOTCHAS
===============================================================================

1. Set LAYERED_VQA_DATASET *and* --dataset_file to the SAME file.
   run_simulations.py reads only the flag; snowball, recap and the viewer read
   only the env var. A mismatch produces runs that look fine and answer the
   wrong condition.

2. The zeros are load-bearing. --N_full_runs, --N_concat_runs and
   --N_sharded_runs all default to 1, so omitting them runs extra conditions.

3. --N_*_runs is a TARGET COUNT PER SAMPLE, not a total. These pilot files hold
   1 sample each. Pointing these commands at the real 300-sample
   layered_vqa_*.json files would run 300 conversations per condition.

4. --user_agent is MANDATORY on the four image-carrying datasets
   (visual_canonical, aligned_vq, misaligned_vq, visual_evidence_*): the driver
   refuses to default it, because reveal order is the manipulation. An explicit
   `--user_agent llm` is allowed there as its own arm and logs under a different
   conv_type, so the two never mix.

5. Recap must follow its sharded run. RECAP_Q needs #3, RECAP_V needs #7.

6. Runs resume. Each launch counts what is already logged for that conv_type and
   runs only the shortfall, so re-running after an interruption costs only what
   was missing. This is also why changing a temperature or a --user_agent starts
   a FRESH set of runs rather than resuming: both are part of the conv_type.

7. A judge outage is a failed run, not a zero — grading raises before any log
   write, so the next launch redoes that conversation instead of freezing a
   false is_correct:false into the results.

8. OUTSTANDING: agents.yaml has assistant.per_simulator.recap.reasoning_max_tokens
   = 3000. This model needs ~3800+ tokens just to finish thinking, so RECAP will
   likely truncate to empty content and score a false zero. Raise it to 8000
   (matching the judge) before trusting RECAP_Q / RECAP_V results.


===============================================================================
OUTPUT
===============================================================================
logs/layered_vqa/<conv_type>/<conv_type>_layered_vqa_qwen3.5-9b.jsonl
logs/layered_vqa/judge_cache.jsonl

One JSON record per conversation: full trace, is_correct, score, judge_model and
the git commit. logs/ is gitignored.

Inspect in the browser:
  $PY -m streamlit run app_conv_viewer.py

Expected conv_type folders after all 16:
  full                        (#1 FULL, #1b/#1c EXP-A, #6 CONCAT_V — distinguished by dataset_fn)
  concat                      (#2)
  sharded                     (#3)
  recap-*                     (#4, #8)
  snowball                    (#5)
  sharded-scripted            (#7, #10 x2, #11, #12)
  snowball-scripted           (#9)
  shuffle-concat              (#13)
  sharded-scripted-shuffle    (#14)
